title: fix: align Qwen3.8 27B pricing
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Updates the pinned OpenRouter Chutes FP8 cost sheet from $0.40/$0.04/$3.00 to $0.35/$0.035/$2.75 per 1M input/cache-read/output tokens.
- Applies the same verified input rate to text, image, and video inputs; `priceMultiplier: 1` keeps user pricing aligned exactly.
- Preserves the canonical name, paid-only status, Chutes pin, disabled provider fallback, capabilities, and no Pollinations fallback.
- Verified against the [exact OpenRouter endpoint listing](https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/qwen/qwen3.8-27b/endpoints) and direct Chutes responses for text, image, video, and cache-read usage.
- Local E2E verified `/v1/models`, non-streaming and streaming usage, output-cache HIT, exact wallet debit/tracking, 51 pricing tests, both service typechecks, and Biome.

gist.headline: The price tags stopped drifting
gist.blurb: Qwen3.8 27B's Chutes price tags have been replanted at their verified rates. The meter now counts text, images, video, and cached tokens from the same honest little ruler.
gist.summary: Corrected Qwen3.8 27B's pinned Chutes FP8 pricing to $0.35/$0.035/$2.75 per million input, cache-read, and output tokens, with the same $0.35 input rate applied to text, image, and video inputs.
gist.impact: Qwen3.8 27B usage now debits wallets and reports costs at the verified Chutes rates across normal, streaming, multimodal, and cache-hit requests.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-market price correction for the Qwen3.8 27B model: Polli carefully replaces mismatched token price tags on a small CRT terminal and three labeled jars representing text, image, and video inputs. Tiny code-plants and a cache jar make the accounting theme readable, while the monitor robot checks the numbers with eager pixel eyes.
